source: spec/05-graph.md AGSC-05-34 (frozen at 1.1.0). The SPARQL text is the example text of the query page (AGSC-06-39); the engine does not run it (AGSC-05-11).

questions.question: If I choose X, what else must I take?
questions.subject: slug X
questions.answer: slugs reached from X by one or more requires edges
questions.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?x dcterms:requires+ ?item } ORDER BY ?item

questions.question: What can never go with X?
questions.subject: slug X
questions.answer: slugs with an excludes edge to or from X, after AGSC-03-05
questions.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?x asc:excludes ?item } ORDER BY ?item

questions.question: What replaced X, directly or through a chain?
questions.subject: slug X
questions.answer: slugs reached from X by one or more superseded-by edges
questions.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?x dcterms:isReplacedBy+ ?item } ORDER BY ?item

questions.question: What does X need that nobody in my selection provides?
questions.subject: slug X, selection S
questions.answer: the names in consumes of X that are in no produces of X or of a member of S
questions.sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?name WHERE { ?x asc:consumes ?name
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { VALUES ?p { ?x <S...> } ?p asc:produces ?name } } ORDER BY ?name

questions.question: What verifies X, and what does X verify?
questions.subject: slug X
questions.answer: an object with verified_by, the slugs with a verifies edge to X, and verifies, the slugs X has a verifies edge to

questions.question: What blocks task T, directly or through a chain?
questions.subject: slug T
questions.answer: slugs reached from T by one or more blocked-by edges
questions.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?x asc:blockedBy+ ?item } ORDER BY ?item

questions.question: Where did lesson L come from?
questions.subject: slug L
questions.answer: an object with lineage, the slugs reached from L by one or more derived-from edges, and episodes, those of them whose type is episode
questions.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?class WHERE { ?x prov:wasDerivedFrom+ ?item . ?item a ?class } ORDER BY ?item

questions.question: Which items sit under cluster C and its sub-clusters?
questions.subject: slug C
questions.answer: an object with clusters, the clusters reached from C by one or more nesting edges (AGSC-05-19), and items, the items other than clusters that list C or one of those clusters in clusters[]
questions.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?x skos:member+ ?item } ORDER BY ?item

questions.question: Which of my selected items are stale, draft or deprecated?
questions.subject: selection S, instant t
questions.answer: the members of S that have a reason, each an object with slug and reasons, in slug order, reasons being those of deprecated, draft, retired and stale that hold, in that order (stale: stale_after earlier than t, AGSC-02-11; the others: status, AGSC-02-23)

questions.question: Which sources back X, and which other items share them?
questions.subject: slug X
questions.answer: an object with sources, the resource strings of X, and shared, an array of objects {items, resource}, in order of resource, one for each of them that another item also cites, items being the slugs of those other items
